title: riglab.skin v1
description: The `manifest.json` of one pixel art set's bundle under `riglab-skins/` (src/export/skin.ts, buildSkinBundle): a skin or a weapon's art, the rig whose slots it draws, and its palette and parts pinned by byte length and SHA-256. The palette file is a `riglab.palette` v1 and every part file a `riglab.part` v1. Rules this schema cannot express, which a reader must check against the bundle and the export: each entry's `bytes` and `sha256` match its file, and the bundle holds exactly the manifest and the files it lists, each once; `rig` names the exported rig; a skin lists one part per rig bone, in bone order, each with that bone's slot; a weapon lists one part per body of the weapon named `name`, in body order, each with the body's name and slot; a part's file is `parts/<slot stem>.part.json`, the stem being the slot after its first `_`, so bodies that share a slot share a file.

generator.description: The RigLab build that wrote the bundle.

name.description: 1-64 letters, digits, '_' or '-', starting with a letter.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the file's bytes.

skin-part.description: A skin's part on one rig slot.

weapon-part.description: A weapon body's part on the body's slot.
